author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: groom on the left with a circular head, rounded-shoulder jacket with a V collar and two legs; bride on the right framed by a hood-shaped veil falling to her shoulders, V neckline and flared gown; figures 8 apart. Human references: full_body_ref.png (circular heads, simple torsos, dress figure) and user.svg (rounded shoulders). Groom head gap verified analytically: collar corners (8,23) and (18,23) are 13 from head centre (13,11), minus r5 = 8 centerline / 4 ink, and they are the nearest body points; the checker passes it. A first candidate was rejected: the tie sat 7 from the jacket sides (MIC), and veil lines hugging the bride's head merged into a blob. The rejected drawing had a small groom head and an unclear bride.
omissions: The bride's face and fringe inside the veil are omitted (no face circle fits 8 units inside a 48px veil); the veil itself frames the head. The groom's jacket centre line becomes a V collar. The bride is attached head-to-body through the veil, so only the groom carries a detached-head flag.
drawing_plan: Groom: head r5 (13,11), collar V (8,23)-(13,28)-(18,23), jacket x 6..20 hem 36, legs x 9/17. Bride: veil hood r5 arch at (35,11) down to y=23, V neckline to (35,27), gown to hem 28..42 at y=42.
lucide_reference: Lucide 'users': circular heads, rounded shoulders, figures spaced apart; human proportions from icon_set/references/human_ref.
